title: Multi-omic state-map pipeline: RNA + metabolic-flux clustering with cross-species validation (methods demonstration)
description: Methods demonstration of a multi-omic clustering pipeline. The state-map and 30-gene panel analyses were developed on pseudo-bulk profiles derived from public human melanoma scRNA-seq datasets (GSE115978, GSE72056) as a stand-in expression dataset; the resulting clusters, accuracy figures and gene rankings characterize melanoma-derived profiles, not cultivated-meat cell states. Domain-relevant components use bovine (GSE173199), porcine (GSE206914) and bovine single-nucleus (GSE240556) muscle/myogenic data. Includes METAFlux flux integration, VAE embeddings, Bayesian Gaussian mixture modeling, TF enrichment (JASPAR), PPI network (STRING), SHAP explainability, bootstrap stability and ML model comparison.
